CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified, its presentation/organization is listed (full-grid), and an origin/status entry distinguishes its provenance for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim is bound to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report lists identified contents (color assignments) with coordinate attributes for specific referents/times.

D.rationale: Origins/kind fields separately attribute provenance/status distinct from the content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: The report describes how content is presented (coordinate groupings, full-grid vs partitioned layouts) for current and conditional candidate referents.
